edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC3 Partner portal R required (exception X2)
    Given the caller holds Partner portal R only
    When the caller asks for the breach and the sample
    Then 403 with MSG-P4-002 is answered before the sample is read and before the record is written

  Scenario: AC4 Required value absent (exception X3)
    Given a check arrives with no partner reference, no check date or no sample set
    When the branch runs
    Then the check is refused, nothing is written and MSG-GEN-001 names the missing field

  Scenario: AC5 Stale batch status (exception X4)
    Given the batch status the sample depends on is not today's
    When the branch runs
    Then the check does not run on stale data, nothing is recorded as a finding and MSG-P1-001 is shown

  Scenario: AC6 Sample owner unavailable (exception X5)
    Given a sample owner's read does not answer inside 2 s or its breaker is open
    When the check runs
    Then no finding is raised, the check is retried on the workflow's own schedule and the caller sees the platform 503 envelope

  Scenario: AC7 No rule version in force (exception X6)
    Given the UNIVERSAL rule package has no version in force for R-UNI-29 or R-LIT-22
    When the branch runs
    Then the branch waits, no finding is recorded and no status moves

  Scenario: AC8 Repeat check (exception X7)
    Given the entry for the same partner and check date already exists
    When the same check arrives again
    Then the existing entry is answered and nothing is written, suspended or escalated again

  Scenario: AC9 Set already moved (exception X8)
    Given the partner already reads SUSPENDED or an instruction already reads RECALLED
    When the upheld breach is applied
    Then the open set is taken as it stands, the entry names the set it moved and no instruction is moved twice

  Scenario: AC10 Boundary breach (exception X9)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches a v_ace_* view, a rwb_case, rwb_comms or rwb_decision row
    When the boundary test runs
    Then the grant refuses the statement, the build fails and nothing is released
